title: Python collection selection notes
text: Lists retain order and allow duplicate values. Sets keep distinct hashable elements and support membership and set operations. Dictionaries associate unique hashable keys with values. Choose a collection from the behavior the program requires rather than from habit.

title: Relational key notes
text: A primary key identifies a row in its table. A foreign key constrains values to refer to compatible rows in another table or to be null when the schema permits it. These constraints preserve identity and referential integrity; indexes are a separate performance concern.
permitted_use: Original project summary linking to official SQLite documentation

title: Git commit workflow notes
text: The working tree contains checked-out files. The staging area records the content selected for the next commit. A commit stores that staged snapshot in local history. Fetching, staging, committing, and pushing are distinct operations.
permitted_use: Original project summary linking to the Git project book

title: Breadth-first search notes
text: Breadth-first search explores an unweighted graph in layers from a start vertex. A queue preserves the frontier order. The first discovered path to a vertex has the fewest edges when every edge has equal weight.
